mapper.select: SELECT e.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Evaluation e LEFT JOIN Activity a ON e.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.eval_id = #{evalId}

SELECT e.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Evaluation e LEFT JOIN Activity a ON e.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY e.eval_time DESC

SELECT e.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Evaluation e LEFT JOIN Activity a ON e.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.eval_time DESC

SELECT e.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Evaluation e LEFT JOIN Activity a ON e.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.activity_id = #{activityId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Evaluation e LEFT JOIN Activity a ON e.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY e.eval_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Evaluation(activity_id, user_id, rating, content, eval_time) VALUES(#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW())
